g.text: Paired contrasts against redistributing B · this baseline is outside the matched-investment comparison

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: Investing and redistributing B create different physical paths. Both use updated beliefs and receive the same reporting opportunities.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6a78

g.text: These contrasts include both material and learning effects. Better prediction or more terminal wealth need not increase consumption.
